display_title: Like Spring Fluttering Across the Snowy Mountains
description:
**Original Webtoon:**    
R19: [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/3498026239)    
R15: [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/3498026240) 

Bihyeon infiltrates the Northern Sea Dragon Palace to rescue her friend Dalgi, who vanished after being sent as a human offering. Instead, she is discovered and ends up taken hostage by Muwon, the Black Dragon. While imprisoned in what turns out to be a surprisingly comfortable captivity, Bihyeon is haunted by recurring prophetic dreams of an intimate encounter with an unknown man—who looks suspiciously like Muwon himself. As fate, captivity, and desire intertwine, she begins to question whether the future she foresaw is already closing in on her.
